newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close mixed, book squaring.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close mixed, book squaring.

text.p: UK grain futures closed mixed amid light book-squaring ahead of the Christmas holiday period, traders said. Wheat futures ended 0.10 to 0.15 sterling down, while barley finished 0.25 to 1.25 sterling up on the traded positions of Jan and Mar. Volume totalled 128 lots and 50 lots respectively.
The delivered market was at a vitrtual standstill with Norfolk/Suffolk virtually the only area to attract any business.
Feed wheat to Norfolk/Suffolk traded at 99.50 sterling for Jan, while Avonmouth made 98.50 stg also for Jan.
Feed barley to Norfolk/Suffolk fetched 100.00 and 102.50 stg for Jan/Mar and Apr/Jun respectively.
Due to the Christmas holiday period the next report will be issued on Friday, December 27.
